image_description: A black and white photograph of a large, complex radio telescope structure. The image features a massive parabolic dish antenna constructed from an intricate lattice of metal trusses and mesh, rather than solid panels. A rectangular receiver cabin or feed structure is suspended at the focal point by a support arm extending from the rim. The entire assembly is mounted on a heavy steel framework against an overcast sky.

The silhouette of the dish clearly follows a concave parabolic arc, consistent with the geometry required for focusing radio waves.

The top rectangular capping/rim appears slightly warped and does not maintain a perfectly straight linear perspective relative to the rest of the structure, suggesting minor geometric instability.
